For the actual product level subgroups at a finite family of selected original places, the quotient is proved to be the product of the original local quotients. Its maximal primary quotient is constructed directly from the original group by the power-image kernel; no cyclic decomposition is assumed. The existing group-algebra theorems then derive locality, the augmentation description of every maximal ideal, and complete compact Noetherian maximal-adic coefficient data for this literal auxiliary group algebra. Every finite group separated by the actual decreasing reduction kernels embeds in one finite-depth image. The repository original matrix congruence image theorem and adic separation therefore prove that finite subgroups of the genuine residual congruence kernel are residue-primary. Faithful coefficient transport retains the same finite local subgroup. Native rational cyclotomic irreducibility, the minimal-polynomial divisibility theorem and Cayley-Hamilton prove that a nonidentity prime-order rational endomorphism has dimension at least p-1. Restricting the original number-field matrix action to the same rational vector space excludes every residue-primary torsion matrix when card(iota)*[K:Q] < p-1. The original definite Hermitian arithmetic stabilizers are already finite by compactness; their faithful conjugated local congruence images now prove their triviality. The exact auxiliary-module consumer derives finite freeness and the unnormalized weighted trace comparison from this literal level condition. Neither an arithmetic-smallness nor a local torsion-free certificate is supplied. The existing original finite-adelic Galois action constructs the actual place-permuting CM involution, proves its continuity and compatibility with principal elements, and defines the original finite-adelic unitary subgroup preserving the specified form. The principal arithmetic inclusion and closedness are proved. Properness of every original completion makes the product of original valuation rings compact, hence the integral finite adeles compact. Native matrix subrings and compact unit subgroups give the compact open original integral matrix level and its unitary intersection. The actual local integral matrix map and residue topology construct a compact open principal refinement at any specified original finite place. At residue characteristic p with card(iota)*[K:Q] < p-1, the existing arithmetic congruence theorem proves triviality of its conjugate arithmetic stabilizers. Every open refinement has finite quotient. The exact consumer therefore proves finite freeness of the original weighted automorphic function module over the actual level quotient group algebra and identifies coinvariants by the original unnormalized weighted trace, without supplied ambient group, principal inclusion, compactness, local congruence, smallness or finite level-quotient certificates. Euclid, original lying-over and the actual residue comparison also construct an original place of residue characteristic above the required size bound outside any finite list of rational primes. The exact existence consumer constructs a compact open principal unitary level with trivial arithmetic stabilizers, with no supplied prime or level witness.

routeAssessment: Reuse was checked before expanding the source quotient. Pinned Matrix.BlockTriangular inverse stability gives the parabolic group; MonoidHom.toHomUnits and native local-ring unit lifting give its residue character and surjectivity without a full matrix-lifting theorem. The repository OriginalAdicCompletionResidue supplies the original arithmetic residue comparison and finiteness. The existing rational cyclotomic power-image argument is adapted to the actual finite cyclic residue-unit group. Its necessary finite-family extension uses a direct finite commutative power-image universal property, avoiding a classification of finite abelian groups. Existing finite-primary group-algebra locality and completeness are reused without new topology infrastructure. Current FLT quaternionic finite-double-coset proofs were inspected; their division-algebra/GL2 setting does not by itself prove finiteness for the source arbitrary-rank unitary group, so no such claim is imported. General parabolic theory, arbitrary reductive groups and classification of finite abelian groups are deferred. The refreshed reuse check found the repository MatrixCongruenceKernelImages and AdicMatrixProductEmbedding already prove the needed finite-depth primary groups and actual separation. The finite stabilizer route only needs a faithful rational arithmetic action, so native cyclotomic irreducibility and characteristic polynomials replace a new local logarithm, general Selberg lemma or local matrix torsion theory. The stronger elementary size condition on the auxiliary prime is a permissible construction target for a sufficiently large auxiliary prime, and its existence with the other source conditions remains explicit work. No given source assumption or conclusion is silently weakened. The original Hermitian arithmetic finiteness and auxiliary trace consumer are reused directly. The pinned native compact-submonoid unit theorem, matrix subring and units equivalence, open maximal-ideal theorem and compact/open quotient finiteness replace separate unit topology and quotient finiteness developments. The existing original Galois adelic action handles the essential permutation of CM places; no coordinatewise fake conjugation is introduced. The large-prime arithmetic smallness result is consumed directly. The current FLT finite_doubleCoset result applies to a central division/quaternion algebra with its GL2 rigidification and does not establish the required arbitrary-rank unitary arithmetic quotient. No local logarithm or general adelic reduction theory is introduced in this increment.
